items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: J.M. Rivers wasn't our band leader. You probably know J.M. Rivers.

ctx.x: Did you, I mean when you said, did you travel with the band?

Oh yeah, a lot of time I'd travel with them. Months and months I used to travel with them. I'd sit out and book up maybe fifteen or twenty nights and then I'd leave with them. Oh, okay. I'd leave with them. So I'd keep them in line, you see. Yeah. I'd keep them in line. I'd give them orders and if they didn't follow the order they would find their whole salary. Sometimes they would find three times of their salary. They wouldn't buy any issues, you know. And I had a pretty good set of musicians. J.M. Rivers…
So, that's John, that's, what's his name on the right?
